_doc: Status palette for framework-free renderers. Typed data, loaded by src/models/tokens/status-palette.ts. Declared in this repo for now; moving it into a core theme instance is step S2 of the view-centric interfaces plan, not part of this source. Every colour is checked against the theme surface it sits on (WCAG 4.5:1) by src/tokens/artifact.test.ts, and every status names an icon token so colour is never the only signal.
